title: 老龄化与健康意识提升：亚洲医疗增长机遇巨大，信诺高管为何看好？
speaker: Jason Salar

segments.en: I think if you look at the fundamentals here, the aging population, growing chronic diseases, and as I said earlier, just growing awareness about the importance of keeping healthy,
segments.zh: 我认为，从基本面来看，人口老龄化、慢性病增加，以及我之前提到的健康意识的提升，

segments.en: we believe that there's a immense opportunity for growth here. Again, that combined with a long history we have both here in Hong Kong and also in China. We're really excited about what that means for us as a global health services company.
segments.zh: 我们相信这里蕴藏着巨大的增长机遇。再加上我们在香港和中国内地的悠久历史，作为一家全球健康服务公司，我们对未来感到非常兴奋。

segments.en: Yeah, and are people getting sick less? Do you think because of healthier lifestyles? I mean, how do you look at this sort of fitness boom that we're seeing globally as well?
segments.zh: 那么，人们是否因为更健康的生活方式而减少生病？您如何看待全球范围内的健身热潮？

segments.en: I mean, definitely, we want people to take responsibility for the health detailsly, exercise regularly.
segments.zh: 当然，我们希望人们对自己的健康负责，定期锻炼。

segments.en: But at the same time, because of the advances of technology data, we're probably picking up diseases actually earlier than we would say even 10 or 15 years ago.
segments.zh: 但同时，由于技术和数据的进步，我们可能比10年或15年前更早地发现疾病。

segments.en: Now, that's positive in terms of the earlier you catch something, the more likelihood you can actually address the problem early.
segments.zh: 这是积极的，因为越早发现，就越有可能及早解决问题。

segments.en: But what that means is, and that's one of the things with the affordability issue, there's more actual utilization as a result of that.
segments.zh: 但这也意味着，由于可负担性问题，实际医疗使用量会增加。

segments.en: Jason, that's a very interesting point you make. Also, coming on a day where there's a lot of, I suppose, enthusiasm surrounding an anti-aging drug that Encilico has made progress on.
segments.zh: Jason，你说得很有意思。今天市场对Encilico在抗衰老药物方面的进展充满热情。

segments.en: I mean, does this sort of shift the focus more on prevention rather than treatment when it comes to health care? I mean, how do you view something like that?
segments.zh: 这是否意味着医疗保健的重点更多转向预防而非治疗？您如何看待这类进展？

segments.en: I mean, prevention has always been a core focus for us. I mean, our mission is to help people we serve improve their health and vitality. We want them to live a long, healthy life.
segments.zh: 预防一直是我们的核心关注点。我们的使命是帮助人们改善健康和活力，希望他们健康长寿。

segments.en: And again, more and more you're seeing developments in that space. And as you mentioned now, even with pharmacy companies looking at improving longevity, tighter, good health.
segments.zh: 我们越来越多地看到该领域的发展。正如你提到的，甚至制药公司也在研究延长寿命、改善健康。
